findings.finding: The committed contract records that this route opens on the later of court-certified completion and the dismissal or closure order, and separates it from active admission into nonadjudication.
findings.consequence: The packet states both anchors and tells a participant still on nonadjudication to stop. A packet that ignored the separation would send someone to court in the middle of their own programme.

findings.finding: The retired legacy Mississippi generator covered Mississippi expungement routes, and its assets are preserved under ADR-0004.
findings.consequence: Nothing from it was used as authority, no commercial route is opened, and this build touches no runtime.
